project.name: CometArt
project.l_desc: A social network website focused on image content.
project.b_desc: This website was developed as the final project for the Higher Vocational Training in Web Development using React and FastAPI (Python). The project is an image-focused social network where users can publish, edit, and delete posts, comment on images, add them to favorites, follow other users, view profiles, and contact them.
